title: Subject Three
transcript:
The showers, water running so the guard can't hear.
Kabir on his knees beside him, scratching lines round the floor drain with a sharpened spoon.

KABIR:
"Everything in this place drains to the old reservoir. Kitchen. Showers. Your pool. Everything."

KABIR:
"Sump under Maintenance. Then the culvert. Under the wall. Then out."

PARTH:
"How long underwater?"

KABIR:
"Too long, for a man who can't count."

He grins and scratches four marks between the lines. Two. Seven. One. Eight.
